pairs.target: lán wǎn lǐ zhuāng de shì dīngzi .
pairs.english: The blue bowl held nails.
pairs.hanzi: 蓝碗里装的是钉子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài ménbiān kàn le yíhuìer , sè lā cái fāxiàn tā zài kàn shénme ,
pairs.english: Tavi stood by the door looking for a while before Sela noticed what he was watching,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在门边看了一会儿，瑟拉才发现他在看什么，

pairs.target: shēnshǒu bǎ wǎn duān zǒu , huālāyìshēng dǎo jìn tiěhé .
pairs.english: picked up the bowl, and emptied it into a tin with a clatter.
pairs.hanzi: 伸手把碗端走，哗啦一声倒进铁盒。

pairs.target: " xǐxǐ jiù néng yòng . yòu búshì zhuāng guò yào . "
pairs.english: “Wash it and it's fine. It wasn't holding medicine.”
pairs.hanzi: “洗洗就能用。又不是装过药。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ bāo fàngxià , xiào zhe qù ná shuǐ .
pairs.english: He set down his bag and went for water, smiling.
pairs.hanzi: 他把包放下，笑着去拿水。

pairs.target: mén hòu de ǎidèng huàn le gè wèizhì , gěi sè lā ràngchū shēntuǐ de dìfāng ;
pairs.english: The low stool behind the door had moved to leave Sela room to stretch her legs;
pairs.hanzi: 门后的矮凳换了个位置，给瑟拉让出伸腿的地方；

pairs.target: zhuōshàng hái bǎi zhe tā dāngtiān fèn dào de xiǎobāo liàojiàn , yǐjīng shù hǎo , děng bàngwǎn yǒurén lái shōu .
pairs.english: her day's packets of parts sat counted on the table, awaiting collection at dusk.
pairs.hanzi: 桌上还摆着她当天分到的小包料件，已经数好，等傍晚有人来收。

pairs.target: jiālǐ bìng méi yīnwèi tā huílái , jiù tíngxiàlái děng tā kàn .
pairs.english: The household hadn't stopped just because he was back, waiting to be looked at.
pairs.hanzi: 家里并没因为他回来，就停下来等他看。

pairs.target: fànhòu bó yà guòlái , dài zhe yìběn biānjiǎo bèi yóu jìn hēi de jiùzhàng .
pairs.english: After lunch Boya came with an old ledger whose corners were blackened by oil.
pairs.hanzi: 饭后博娅过来，带着一本边角被油浸黑的旧账。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tā gē zài gānjìng de bù shàng , ràng tǎ wéi xiān bié fān , zìjǐ cóng hòumiàn shù dào jiá zhe cǎozhǐ de yíyè .
pairs.english: She laid it on a clean cloth and told Tavi not to turn the pages yet, counting from the back to a page marked with rough paper.
pairs.hanzi: 她把它搁在干净的布上，让塔维先别翻，自己从后面数到夹着草纸的一页。

pairs.target: " zhǐnéng bǎ niánfèn wǎng zhèlǐ kào . " tā shuō , " bùnéng dàngchéng nàtiān de jìlù . "
pairs.english: “This only puts the year somewhere around here,” she said. “It isn't a record from that day.”
pairs.hanzi: “只能把年份往这里靠。”她说，“不能当成那天的记录。”

pairs.target: nà shì yuē shísìnián qián de dōng méi zhàng .
pairs.english: It was a winter coal ledger from about fourteen years ago.
pairs.hanzi: 那是约十四年前的冬煤账。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuìchū lái jiālǐ de dōngtiān , sè lā jìde huàn guò yícì méi shāng , bó yà yě jìde jiù diàn guānmén ;
pairs.english: Sela remembered changing coal suppliers in Tavi's first winter at home; Boya remembered the old shop closing too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维最初来家里的冬天，瑟拉记得换过一次煤商，博娅也记得旧店关门；

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén xiān gèzì bǎ jìde de shì xiěxià , zài zhǎo zhàng xiāngduì , dàzhì luò zài zhè yìnián .
pairs.english: They'd each written down their memories first, then compared them with the accounts, arriving roughly at this year.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人先各自把记得的事写下，再找账相对，大致落在这一年。

pairs.target: zhàngběn jiá yè shàng nà jù " háizi de hòu bù ", quèshì hòulái zhěnglǐ jiùzhàng shí bǔ de , méiyǒu rìqī .
pairs.english: But “thick cloth for the child,” on the inserted page, had been added later while sorting old accounts, without a date.
pairs.hanzi: 账本夹页上那句“孩子的厚布”，却是后来整理旧账时补的，没有日期。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎshǒu cóng zhuō yán yíkāi .
pairs.english: Tavi moved his hand from the table's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把手从桌沿移开。

pairs.target: tā gāng kànjiàn " háizi " liǎnggè zì , xīn yǐjīng xiān tiào le yíxià .
pairs.english: The moment he'd seen “child,” his heart had jumped ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 他刚看见“孩子”两个字，心已经先跳了一下。

pairs.target: " hòu bù shì gěi wǒ de ? " " shì . " sè lā shuō ,
pairs.english: “The thick cloth was for me?” “Yes,” Sela said.
pairs.hanzi:
“厚布是给我的？”
“是。”瑟拉说，

pairs.target: " kěbúshì guǒ nǐ huílái de nà jiàn yīshang . zhè shì hòulái mǎi de . "
pairs.english: “But not the coat you came wrapped in. We bought this later.”
pairs.hanzi: “可不是裹你回来的那件衣裳。这是后来买的。”

pairs.target: bó yà bǎ běnzi tuī jìn xiē .
pairs.english: Boya pushed the book closer.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅把本子推近些。

pairs.target: mò de yánsè bùtóng , bǔ zì jǐ zài liǎngbǐ méi qián zhījiān .
pairs.english: The ink differed in colour; the added words squeezed between two coal payments.
pairs.hanzi: 墨的颜色不同，补字挤在两笔煤钱之间。

pairs.target: tā kàn míngbái le , yě réng juéde nà liǎnggè zì qīnjìn ,
pairs.english: He understood, yet still felt close to those words,
pairs.hanzi: 他看明白了，也仍觉得那两个字亲近，

pairs.target: fǎngfú zìjǐ yuánxiān zhǐyǒu yìtuán móhu de yǐngzi , rújīn zài jiù zhǐ shàng zhàn dào le xiǎoxiǎode yìháng .
pairs.english: as if he'd been only a blurred shadow before, and now occupied one small line on old paper.
pairs.hanzi: 仿佛自己原先只有一团模糊的影子，如今在旧纸上占到了小小的一行。

pairs.target: tā lìng xiě le yìzhāng zhǐ : yuē shísìnián qián , dōngtiān ;
pairs.english: He wrote on a separate sheet: About fourteen years ago, in winter;
pairs.hanzi: 他另写了一张纸：约十四年前，冬天；

pairs.target: yījù shì jiāzhōng duì méi shāng gēnghuàn de jìyì , búshì fāxiàn dāngtiān de huòdān .
pairs.english: based on the household's memory of changing coal suppliers, not a manifest from the day he was found.
pairs.hanzi: 依据是家中对煤商更换的记忆，不是发现当天的货单。

pairs.target: bó yà kàn wán , shuō zhèyàng tā cái gǎn tì tā jì .
pairs.english: Boya read it and said only then would she dare post it for him.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅看完，说这样她才敢替他寄。

pairs.target: sè lā yìzhí méiyǒu shuōhuà .
pairs.english: Sela had remained silent.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉一直没有说话。

pairs.target: tā ná qǐ zhàngběn , mǔzhǐ zài " hòu bù " pángbiān cā le yíxià , xiàng yào bǎ nà diǎn yóuzì cādiào .
pairs.english: She lifted the ledger and rubbed beside “thick cloth” with her thumb, as though wiping off a spot of oil.
pairs.hanzi: 她拿起账本，拇指在“厚布”旁边擦了一下，像要把那点油渍擦掉。

pairs.target: " nà shíhòu nǐ shuìjiào yào zhuā dōngxī . " tā hūrán shuō , " zhuā búdào jiù xǐng .
pairs.english: “You had to clutch something to sleep then,” she suddenly said. “Couldn't find anything, and you'd wake up.”
pairs.hanzi: “那时候你睡觉要抓东西。”她忽然说，“抓不到就醒。

pairs.target: wǒ de xiùkǒu bèi nǐ jiū dé fèngxiàn quán sōng le . "
pairs.english: “You pulled the stitching right out of my cuffs.”
pairs.hanzi: 我的袖口被你揪得缝线全松了。”

pairs.target: " wǒ búshì yìzhí hěn shěngshì ? " " shuí shuō de ? " " nǐ . "
pairs.english: “Wasn't I always easy to look after?” “Who said that?” “You.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我不是一直很省事？”
“谁说的？”
“你。”

pairs.target: tā xiǎng le yíxià , xiào le : " nà kěnéng shì gēn gèng nán dài de bǐ . "
pairs.english: She thought, then laughed. “Maybe compared with a harder one.”
pairs.hanzi: 她想了一下，笑了：“那可能是跟更难带的比。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě xiào , què méi lìjí jiē huà .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed too, but didn't answer immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也笑，却没立即接话。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngxiàng yìzhī bǐ xiànzài xiǎodéduō de shǒu , zhuā zhe tā de xiùzǐ ,
pairs.english: He imagined a much smaller hand clutching her sleeve,
pairs.hanzi: 他想象一只比现在小得多的手，抓着她的袖子，

pairs.target: hūrán bù zhīdào nà zhī shǒu zài chēxiāng lǐ zhuā guò shuí .
pairs.english: and suddenly wondered who that hand had held inside the carriage.
pairs.hanzi: 忽然不知道那只手在车厢里抓过谁。

pairs.target: wèntí dào le zuǐbiān , yòu mànmàn tuìhuíqù .
pairs.english: The question reached his lips, then slowly retreated.
pairs.hanzi: 问题到了嘴边，又慢慢退回去。

pairs.target: sè lā bù zhīdào , tā wèn dé zài qīng , tā yě háishì bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: Sela didn't know; however gently he asked, she still wouldn't know.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉不知道，他问得再轻，她也还是不知道。

pairs.target: bó yà méiyǒu tì tāmen tián zhè duàn ānjìng .
pairs.english: Boya didn't fill the silence for them.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅没有替他们填这段安静。

pairs.target: tā shōuqǐ zhàng , wèn xìn lǐ yào buyào fùshàng zhè yíyè de chāojiàn .
pairs.english: She put away the ledger and asked whether to enclose a copy of that page.
pairs.hanzi: 她收起账，问信里要不要附上这一页的抄件。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō búyào zhěngyè , méi shāng hé línjū de zhàng méi bìyào gěi bú rènshi de rén kàn ,
pairs.english: Tavi said not the whole page; strangers needn't see the neighbours' and coal seller's accounts.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说不要整页，煤商和邻居的账没必要给不认识的人看，

pairs.target: zhī jì zìjǐ gāng xiě de nà jǐháng .
pairs.english: Just send the few lines he'd written.
pairs.hanzi: 只寄自己刚写的那几行。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ ā duō qiāomén , yí jìnlái jiù wèn yǒuméiyǒu dài huì liàng de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Ado knocked that afternoon, asking as soon as he entered whether Tavi had brought anything that glowed.
pairs.hanzi: 下午阿多敲门，一进来就问有没有带会亮的东西。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ hébiān de tú tānkāi , xiān shuō dēng lǐ shāo de shì yóu , búhuì xiàng xuégōng fàntáng nàyàng .
pairs.english: Tavi spread out his riverside drawing, first explaining that the lamp burned oil, unlike the academy dining hall's.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把河边的图摊开，先说灯里烧的是油，不会像学宫饭堂那样。

pairs.target: tā xiànzài zuò bù chū nàzhǒng dēng .
pairs.english: He couldn't make that sort of lamp yet.
pairs.hanzi: 他现在做不出那种灯。

pairs.target: " néng zhào jiǎo jiù xíng . " ā duō shuō .
pairs.english: “As long as it lights my feet,” Ado said.
pairs.hanzi: “能照脚就行。”阿多说。

pairs.target: tā dàilái de shì zìjiā yìzhǎn jiù yóudēng , wàiké kē biǎn le yìbiān , tí bǐng què hái láo .
pairs.english: He'd brought an old oil lamp from home, its casing dented on one side but its handle still sound.
pairs.hanzi: 他带来的是自家一盏旧油灯，外壳磕扁了一边，提柄却还牢。

pairs.target: dǎo wán cányóu , mǒ jìng zhǎn yán hòu , tā bǎ dēng jǔ dào xiōngqián ,
pairs.english: After emptying the remaining oil and wiping the cup's rim clean, he held it at his chest,
pairs.hanzi: 倒完残油、抹净盏沿后，他把灯举到胸前，

pairs.target: lìngyìshǒu bǐ chū bào yíluò mùliào de zīshì .
pairs.english: using his other hand to mime carrying a stack of timber.
pairs.hanzi: 另一手比出抱一摞木料的姿势。

pairs.target: " wèntí zài zhèér . liǎngzhīshǒu ná dōngxī , dēng jiù dé yòng zuǐ diāo .
pairs.english: “Here's the problem. Both hands full, and the lamp has to hang from your mouth.”
pairs.hanzi: “问题在这儿。两只手拿东西，灯就得用嘴叼。

pairs.target: nǐ biéshì , yá gè dé huāng . "
pairs.english: “Don't try it. It hurts your teeth.”
pairs.hanzi: 你别试，牙硌得慌。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèngyào xiào , ā duō yǐjīng zhǐzhe tú shàng de yuánhuán wèn , néng bunéng bǎ dēng guà zài yāo cè .
pairs.english: Tavi was about to laugh when Ado pointed at the rings in the drawing and asked if the lamp could hang from his waist.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维正要笑，阿多已经指着图上的圆环问，能不能把灯挂在腰侧。

pairs.target: zuò zhe huàtú shí hěn cōngming de liǎngdào huán , dào le kùdài páng , hūrán duō le pèng tuǐ , huàng yóu , tàng yīfu de yìduī máfán .
pairs.english: Those clever-looking rings on paper suddenly brought problems beside a belt: bumping legs, sloshing oil, scorching clothes.
pairs.hanzi: 坐着画图时很聪明的两道环，到了裤带旁，忽然多了碰腿、晃油、烫衣服的一堆麻烦。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu bǎ zhèxiē huà yìkǒuqì jiǎngwán , zhī bǎ kōng dēng qīngqīng guà zài zìjǐ yāo biān , zǒu le liǎngbù .
pairs.english: Rather than explain everything at once, he gently hung the empty lamp at his waist and took two steps.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有把这些话一口气讲完，只把空灯轻轻挂在自己腰边，走了两步。

pairs.target: dēngké qiāo zhe dàtuǐ , fāchū liǎngshēng mēnxiǎng .
pairs.english: The casing struck his thigh with two dull knocks.
pairs.hanzi: 灯壳敲着大腿，发出两声闷响。

pairs.target: " wǒ dé dàihuíqù wènwèn , xiān zuò gè bù diǎnhuǒ de yàngzi . "
pairs.english: “I need to take this back and ask. First make a version without lighting it.”
pairs.hanzi: “我得带回去问问，先做个不点火的样子。”

pairs.target: " xíng . bié bǎ zhè zhǎn chāi le , wǒ jīnwǎn hái yòng . "
pairs.english: “All right. Don't dismantle this one; I need it tonight.”
pairs.hanzi: “行。别把这盏拆了，我今晚还用。”

pairs.target: tāmen zhàozhuó shíwùliáng le jǐchù , ā duō tídēng zǒushí , tiān hái liàng zhe .
pairs.english: They took several measurements from the actual lamp; it was still light when Ado carried it away.
pairs.hanzi: 他们照着实物量了几处，阿多提灯走时，天还亮着。

pairs.target: sè lā zài ménnèi jiào tā màndiǎn , tā huítóu yìng le yìshēng , yǐjīng guǎiguò qiángjiǎo .
pairs.english: From indoors Sela called for him to slow down; he turned to answer and was already around the corner.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉在门内叫他慢点，他回头应了一声，已经拐过墙角。

pairs.target: wǎnfàn yòng huí nà zhī lán wǎn .
pairs.english: The blue bowl returned for supper.
pairs.hanzi: 晚饭用回那只蓝碗。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bā le liǎngkǒu , hūrán tíngzhù , sè lā yǐwéi yǒu dīngzi méi jiǎn jìng .
pairs.english: Tavi ate a couple of mouthfuls and suddenly stopped; Sela thought a nail had been left behind.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维扒了两口，忽然停住，瑟拉以为有钉子没捡净。

pairs.target: tā shuō búshì , shì juéde tāng bǐ xuégōng de xián .
pairs.english: He said no, the soup just seemed saltier than at the academy.
pairs.hanzi: 他说不是，是觉得汤比学宫的咸。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shuǐhú tuī gěi tā . " nà jiù zìjǐ duì .
pairs.english: She pushed the water jug towards him. “Then dilute it yourself.”
pairs.hanzi: 她把水壶推给他。“那就自己兑。

pairs.target: chūqù zhù le xiē rìzi , hái dé quánjiā gēn nǐ gǎi kǒuwèi ? "
pairs.english: “Live away a little while, and the whole family must change its tastes for you?”
pairs.hanzi: 出去住了些日子，还得全家跟你改口味？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gěi zìjǐ tiān le shuǐ , yě gěi tā tiān le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi added water to his bowl, and a little to hers as well.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维给自己添了水，也给她添了一点。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn le , méi lán .
pairs.english: She saw, and didn't stop him.
pairs.hanzi: 她看见了，没拦。
